change: The AppKit host becomes the engine library NTSDAppKitHost (Mac builds; NTSDCore and NTSDMacPlatform): OriginalRuntimeLaunch.swift (the runtime delegate and OriginalMacSessionHost) by git mv, taking the arguments and the OriginalGame instead of main.swift's global and NTSDContent (music through the game's content of the main bundle, as NTSDContent.location() did), and the app's former runtime branch as NTSDAppKitHost.run(arguments:game:). The lab (main.swift's lab parts, Assets, OriginalScene, MeleeScene, MovementScene) and the dispatcher stay in the game's NTSDApp, which calls the host with NTSDContent.runtimeGame when no lab option is given.
